title: Lab of the Future Europe 2025 Day 2 Plenary Session
content: Lab of the Future Europe Congress 2025 Plenary session on Day 2. This session comprises 3 presentations, followed by a panel discussion and Q&A. Moderator’s Introduction and Overview Becky Upton, President, Pistoia Alliance Presenters and panelists Chris Phillips, Executive Director, AstraZeneca Jesper Lau, Scientific Vice President, External & Exploratory Innovation, Research & Early Development, Novo Nordisk Generoso Ianniciello, Chief Business Officer, Anima Biotech To watch the session, fill in your details below.
